one_line: Foundational Mysore ruler who seized Srirangapatna in 1610 and framed Wodeyar kingship through Mysore Dasara.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early-40s, medium height, sturdy build with a commander’s posture and the calm confidence of a seasoned court-warrior.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown Mysore complexion, neatly groomed short moustache, faint trimmed stubble along the jaw, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, and a composed, observant default expression that softens into a slight, knowing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Black hair pulled back into a tight, low bun at the nape, mostly hidden under a deep maroon, slightly conical Mysore-style turban wrapped smoothly, with a narrow gold border and a small central gold-and-emerald turban ornament at the forehead.
appearance.costume: He wears an early 17th‑century south Indian royal outfit: a long-sleeved knee-length angarkha-style jama in rich deep maroon silk with a subtle gold butti dot pattern and overlapping front panels tied with side fastenings, over a fitted cream cotton inner tunic; a broad, soft gold silk waistband (kamarband) wraps around his midsection with the knot slightly off-center; below, he wears off-white, slightly tapered churidar-style trousers that bunch neatly at the ankles; over the torso is a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton war-vest dyed muted olive green, edged in narrow gold piping, practical yet courtly; on his feet are brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes and simple stitching; jewellery is dignified but not excessive—a single medium-thickness gold chain around his neck, a pair of small gold stud earrings, and one prominent gold ring with a green stone on his right hand; for ceremonial scenes, a fine cream silk shawl with a thin maroon and gold border can be draped over his left shoulder and across the chest.
appearance.signature: A straight-bladed south Indian steel sword with a gently tapering blade, a traditional disc pommel and knuckle-guard hilt of darkened steel inlaid with simple brass, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with minimal metal fittings and usually worn tucked through his gold silk waistband on the left hip.

ref_desc: Raja Wodeyar I has an oval medium-brown face with sharp dark eyes, a short moustache, and black hair in a low bun under a deep maroon gold-trimmed turban, wearing a maroon patterned jama, cream churidar trousers, olive green sleeveless war-vest, gold waistband, brown mojari shoes, light gold jewellery, and carrying a plain brown-sheathed south Indian steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Raja Wodeyar I as a dignified early 17th-century Mysore king and commander: an oval-faced, medium-brown skinned man in his late 30s–40s with sharp dark eyes, thick brows, a neat short moustache and faint jaw stubble, black hair tied in a low bun mostly hidden under a deep maroon Mysore-style turban with a narrow gold border and small central gold-and-emerald ornament; dress him in a long-sleeved knee-length deep maroon silk jama with a subtle gold dot pattern and overlapping front panels, worn over a cream inner tunic, a broad gold silk waistband wrapped around his midsection, and off-white churidar trousers gathered at the ankles; add a fitted sleeveless quilted olive green war-vest with thin gold piping over the torso, simple brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes, a single gold necklace, small gold stud earrings, and one gold ring with a green stone on his right hand; his plain south Indian steel sword with disc-pommel and knuckle-guard hilt rests in a dark brown leather scabbard at his left hip, integrated with the waistband; include a view where a cream silk shawl with a maroon and gold border is draped over his left shoulder for ceremonial depiction, and show him in neutral, three-quarter, and side poses to emphasize consistent face, turban, garments, and colors in deep maroon, cream, olive green, gold, and brown leather.
